name: Peanut Oil
siboNotes: Pure oils are FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO. Use in moderation as excessive fat can slow gastric emptying.
preparationTips: Choose refined peanut oil for high-heat cooking due to its high smoke point
Store in a cool, dark place to prevent rancidity
Use cold-pressed versions for salad dressings and low-heat applications
Check labels to ensure no FODMAP-containing additives are present
